meta_description: Mansuri Contractors Ltd — trusted electrician in Leicester. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, and fault diagnosis. Free quotes. Call 07946 454786.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Reliable Electrical Solutions
hero_subhead: From rewires to fault diagnosis, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work across Leicester with speed and precision.
services_subhead: We specialise in domestic rewires, fault diagnosis, installation work, and emergency callouts for homes and businesses throughout the area.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Modern wiring systems that meet current Building Regulations. We remove old cables safely and install new circuits with updated consumer units, restoring safety and adding capacity for today's appliances.

services.title: Fault Diagnosis & Repair
services.desc: Persistent trips, flickering lights, or dead sockets? We trace faults methodically and fix them right, not just mask the symptom. Most jobs completed same day.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: Additional sockets, USB outlets, smart switches, or outdoor weatherproof boxes. All neatly installed and tested to keep your home functional and your extension leads out of sight.

services.title: Cooker & Appliance Wiring
services.desc: High-power appliances need proper dedicated circuits. We install cookers, ovens, hobs, and electric showers on correctly sized cabling with appropriate protection.

services.title: Periodic Inspections & Testing
services.desc: Five-yearly electrical safety checks (EICR) give you a detailed report on the condition of your wiring and identify any hazards before they cause problems.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Work
services.desc: Businesses need reliable systems. We handle office rewires, workshop installations, lighting upgrades, and maintenance contracts for Leicester's commercial sector.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like we're wiring our own home — proper materials, no shortcuts, done right.
about_para_1: Mansuri Contractors Ltd has served Leicester's homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we were frustrated seeing customers overcharged and left with dodgy work. From that principle, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, thorough diagnostics, and electrical work that lasts.
about_para_2: Our engineers are Part P certified and keep themselves up to date with Building Regulations changes. We turn up on time, explain what's wrong before we fix it, and leave the site clean. Over 400 jobs completed across Leicester — most of our work now comes from word-of-mouth and repeat customers.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that kept tripping the board. Called Mansuri on a Monday morning and Kavi was here by Tuesday afternoon. He found the problem straight away — loose connection in the back box — sorted in minutes. No faffing about, fair price, and he explained exactly what had gone wrong. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1960s semi during a kitchen renovation. The work was immaculate and they coordinated well with the builders. All new circuits, proper labelling, and they tested everything before signing off. The EICR certificate they gave us was brilliant for our insurance. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Patricia B.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out at 9 PM on a Saturday — the consumer unit had arced and blown. Mansuri answered the phone, talked me through safety steps, and had someone round within 90 minutes. Replaced the whole unit properly and checked all circuits. Came in on a weekend without any fuss. Excellent service.
reviews.author: James T.
